capabilities: Capture chosen notes to askMyu, encrypted on the device
Show a Today pane with a morning brief, meetings and commitments
Chat with Myu about a note, selection, person or meeting
Write optional Myu pages, canvases and daily logs into the vault
Connect Google, Microsoft, Slack, Zulip, IMAP mail and CalDAV sources
disambiguation: Not a local AI assistant; it is a client for the hosted askMyu service and requires an account and network access.
extras: Free during the beta; creating an account requires agreeing to Beta Participation Terms and a Privacy Policy. No self-hosting or offline use: one server only, and offline startup leaves the vault locked with capture paused. Meeting notes are the exception to encryption: they are sent readable to the server, behind a separate consent screen. Ships a mock backend for testing and an optional CSS look installed into .obsidian/snippets.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture journal notes into an outside assistant service while keeping them encrypted and keeping the day's brief, meetings and follow-ups visible while you write.

requires.name: Dataview (optional, to read Myu folder properties)

summary: Obsidian plugin that connects a vault to the askMyu service, sending chosen notes encrypted and showing a daily brief, meetings and chat pane beside your notes.
